description:
The whole world can see the missiles flying over the Middle East. But what does life actually look like inside Iran right now? Ahmed Jadallah and his team are the first Reuters journalists to report from Tehran in many years. 
 
In this episode of our podcast On Assignment, Jadallah takes us through the streets of Tehran — into bazaars and bombed-out buildings, through funerals and government rallies — to hear from ordinary Iranians trying to hold their lives together in wartime.
